text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Yasuda Kinen. Looking 
forward to the pudding she brought along, 
Matikane Tannhauser fires herself up to 
race alongside Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Ikuno Dictus, who came by to 
greet her, pointed out that her pudding 
had expired.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Heartened by the kindness of her rival 
Ikuno Dictus, who breathed a sigh of 
relief that she didn't collapse before the 
race, the curtain rises on the Yasuda 
Kinen!
